messages:
ada: Thinking of doing a hybrid LAN night next Friday — modded Minecraft server (lightweight forge pack) + speedrun watch party in the break room projector. Parsec or bring-your-own? :pick:

miguel: love it. count me in for modded mc. can help host server.

taylor: projector watch party sounds perfect. time? I finish at 6pm.

ada: aiming 7pm start. server up at 6:30 for testing.

jen: I'll bring an ethernet switch and some short cables. also can bring popcorn :)

kai: I can stream my laptop via Parsec. FYI my mac has weird audio routing.

noah: I can bring a spare battery pack for anyone with Steam Decks.

miguel: modpack install steps (run once):
```
wget https://example.com/modpack.tar.gz -O /tmp/modpack.tar.gz
tar -xzf /tmp/modpack.tar.gz -C ~/.minecraft/versions/
java -Xmx6G -jar forge-installer.jar
```

ada: awesome — Miguel can we get the server IP and a simple join command in the thread before Friday?

miguel: will spin up on my home server and bring a backup on a Pi in case the office wifi is noisy. IP will be 10.0.2.45 (local). bring ethernet if you can.

taylor: can remote folks watch the speedrun stream? maybe we use Discord screen share.

jen: projector HDMI is limited to 1080p; speedruns are ok.

ops-bot: Reminder: Office event policy requires sign-up for snacks — please RSVP in #random by Thursday.

ada: Poll time — react with :one: for 'LAN + projector in break room', :two: for 'bring your own streaming and we watch remotely', :three: for 'both (hybrid)'.

kai: :one:

noah: :three:

miguel: :one:

taylor: :two:

jen: :one:

ada: Nice. Looks like break room + small remote option. I'll post final plan tomorrow and a short how-to for joining the server.

noah: also headset sharing etiquette: sanitize between uses pls :sponge:

ada: noted — will bring wipes. see y'all Friday! :party-parrot:
